cassia.predicted_cell_type: B-cell lineage, early B-cell precursor / immature B-lymphoid progenitor
strengths: Correctly captures B-lymphoid precursor identity; marker reasoning includes DNTT, VPREB1, VPREB3, IGLL1, EBF1, MME, CD24.
Recognizes the proliferation module (MKI67, TOP2A, CCNB2, CDK1, AURKB) as a proliferating precursor state.
weaknesses: Frozen mapping to CL:0000236 (B cell) is broader than the supported pro-B/precursor branch.
Top marker LCN6 and noncanonical genes are not resolved.
Top1 label is under-specific: the precursor markers (DNTT, VPREB1/3, IGLL1, MME, EBF1) favor the pro-B branch over mature B cell.
Does not separate the supported proliferating precursor state in its top1 label.

strengths: Directly selects the most specific supported branch (pro-B cell) using DNTT, VPREB1, VPREB3, IGLL1, EBF1, MME.
Correctly treats the cell-cycle enrichment as a proliferative state rather than a lineage switch.
weaknesses: Relies on generic proliferation/meiosis terms for state interpretation; no additional lineage-specific terms.

supporting: DNTT, VPREB1, VPREB3, IGLL1, EBF1, MME, CD24 are direct positive markers of B-cell precursor/pro-B identity and favor the pro-B branch over generic B cell.
Proliferation module (MKI67, TOP2A, CCNB2, CDK1, AURKB, PCNA, RRM2, TK1) supports the proliferating pro-B state.
PMID 36658547 was retrieved in the cluster's RAG evidence and is consistent with B-cell precursor annotation.
conflicting: MZB1 indicates a low-level plasma-cell/plasmablast-like signal, not a dominant lineage.
LCN6, CYGB, AKAP12, ARPP21 are noncanonical genes and are not lineage-defining.
Enrichment is dominated by generic cell-cycle terms and does not discriminate B cell vs pro-B cell on its own.
enrichment_or_literature: Cell-cycle/mitotic enrichment (M phase, chromosome segregation, mitotic cell cycle) supports a highly proliferative precursor state.
Hematopoietic lineage pathway enrichment is broadly consistent with a B-lymphoid precursor.
Retrieved RAG literature (e.g., PMID 36658547) supports early B-cell precursor/leukemic blast context.

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, evidence, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
